name: Tatara Phoron
source:
The main protagonist. Phoron is a Dantist working in the Tsuge Divine Music Player Office. Although he is the master of the Red spirit, Corticarte, he doesn't have a full control over her (because Cortica always wants to follow her own will). He plays an organ-like instrument that can transform into a motorbike. He is very kind, but naive and somewhat dense.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Shinkyoku_S%C5%8Dkai_Polyphonica_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
